profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | ZFS, Storage, Performance | C++ + AI-Augmented Development | 30+ Years
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with 30+ years building production systems. Backup architecture at Apple and EMC. VMware's industry-standard backup APIs. DevOps transformation at Delphix. Currently performance engineering on ZFS and storage systems at Delphix/Perforce.

Most senior engineers are either deep in the fundamentals or fluent with AI coding tools. I'm both. Three decades of writing and debugging code line-by-line built the first-principles understanding that lets me leverage AI development tools as a force multiplier rather than a substitute. I review AI-generated code with the same rigor I'd apply to a junior engineer's PR, and I architect the systems where AI is currently a copilot, not a pilot. As AI-generated code volume grows industry-wide, this combination of deep manual skills plus AI-augmented productivity becomes more valuable, not less.

Recent open-source work demonstrating the AI plus C++ engineering combination:

CQL (Claude Query Language): structured prompt compiler for LLM interactions. C++20 with hand-written lexer, parser, AST, and Claude API integration. 250 tests, zero warnings. https://github.com/dbjwhs/cql

inference-systems-lab: C++17 inference platform implementing belief propagation, Mamba SSM, Mixture-of-Experts, neuro-symbolic logic, and SIMD containers. https://github.com/dbjwhs/inference-systems-lab

Song: zero-dependency C++20 microservice framework with custom IDL compiler, binary wire protocol, HMAC-SHA256 security, and process-isolated service hosting. 596 tests across 26K lines. https://github.com/dbjwhs/song

cpp-snippets: advanced C++ patterns covering memory model deep dives, C++20 and C++23 features, full GoF design pattern coverage, probabilistic data structures, and lock-free programming. https://github.com/dbjwhs/cpp-snippets

Returned to Delphix-now-Perforce in October 2025 after a leave to care for my mother during her ALS illness. The same engineering organization hiring me twice is a signal worth reading.

Open to conversations about:
- AI-focused engineering teams where deep fundamentals amplify modern AI-augmented development
- National security and defense technology roles where rigorous engineering serves significant missions
- Senior storage, distributed systems, and performance engineering roles

Bay Area, open to remote with periodic onsite.

https://github.com/dbjwhs

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Bash · Groovy · Linux · Mac · Windows

positions.title: Caregiving
positions.description:
• Career break to become the primary caregiver for my mother, who was battling Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), a progressive neurodegenerative disease
• Had previously built an accessible second home for her to provide 24/7 care, ultimately transitioning to full-time caregiving as her condition advanced
• Made the conscious decision to dedicate this time to ensuring my mother's comfort, dignity, and quality of life during her final months
• Following her passing in February 2024, took time for personal healing while maintaining technical skills through personal C++ development projects (viewable at https://github.com/dbjwhs)
• This profoundly personal experience enhanced my empathy, resilience, and crisis management capabilities • strengths I bring to my next professional role

positions.title: Senior Staff DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• Was part of the team that upgraded DCoL (Data Center on Linux) from Python 2 to Python 3, enhancing the system that leveraged ZFS snapshots for the rapid creation of testing environments
• Served as Lead Engineer for the mission-critical DCoL infrastructure, managing three central systems supported by 30-50 ESX servers in the local data center. This system was a high-performance virtualization infrastructure that could create fully functional testing environments in under one minute through ZFS snapshot integration with VMware ESX via pyvmomi
• Managed daily operations, including user support requests and complex rolling upgrades of ESX systems with minimal service disruption
• Served as Lead Engineer for the organization's JFrog Artifactory and Xray platforms, maintaining this critical artifact repository and security scanning system central to the CI/CD pipeline
• Contributed to regular monthly maintenance and upgrade procedures for Artifactory/Xray while ensuring continuous availability of this business-critical system
• Established comprehensive monitoring solutions to ensure artifact repository performance and security scanning reliability
• Managed critical DevOps infrastructure spanning multiple environments, including on-premises data centers and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
• Contributed to the development of a cross-training rotation system where team members would take ownership of critical systems, handling technical support, upgrades, and feature implementation; this was an industry best in normalizing knowledge of complex systems across our engineering team
• Orchestrated complex deployments using industry-standard tools,s including Jenkins, Ansible, Docker, and Terraform
• Created comprehensive documentation and knowledge transfer processes to ensure operational continuity and reduce single points of failure. This included maintaining our "Runbooks" for all critical systems.
• Interviewed numerous candidates for open positions on our team

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed cloud backup capabilities supporting AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as storage destinations, incorporating fast catalog rebuild features to enhance data reliability and cost-effectiveness
• Designed and implemented IMAP backup functionality that treated email accounts as file systems, enabling efficient backup and restoration of email data from Google, Microsoft, and other providers while preserving folder hierarchies
• Engineered a deterministic testing system using integer-based event generation and logging, allowing precise reproduction of test failures for efficient debugging
• Designed an automated regression prevention system that integrated all P1 defects into the test suite, ensuring critical bugs never reappeared in production
• Implemented performance benchmarking into the CI/CD pipeline, identifying subtle speed regressions during feature development before they impacted customers
• Created a fast catalog rebuild feature that enabled disaster recovery from raw backup media by reconstructing both snapshot trees (full file system layout) and session trees (backed-up files) into the proprietary Catalog File format
• Reduced critical patch release cycle from weeks to less than 24 hours, significantly enhancing the company's ability to respond to customer needs
• Created seamless integration between automated testing and deployment processes, enabling continuous delivery of high-quality software updates
• Established metrics and monitoring systems to quantify quality improvements and development efficiency gains from the automation framework

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Recruited to rejoin Retrospect following its spin-off as an independent data protection company, bringing critical institutional knowledge and technical expertise
• Led development of VMware integration for Retrospect engine as the first assignment, leveraging previous experience from VMware's VDAP/VDDK team to deliver this strategic capability rapidly
• Served as the primary mentor for all junior engineers and college interns, providing one-on-one guidance to accelerate their professional development and technical capabilities
• Architected and implemented a comprehensive CI/CD automation system that revolutionized the company's development workflow and release capabilities
• Developed RAPI, a sophisticated test automation tool leveraging the DAG (Dantz API Generator) framework to enable complete test coverage of the Retrospect engine

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
• Selected by VMware leadership to be part of the hand picked team that implement core backup functionality for the flagship vSphere product, creating a strategic in-house data protection solution VDR, which later was called VMware VDP.
• Leveraged Retrospect Linux engine expertise to develop an integrated backup solution deployed as a virtual machine template running on CentOS
• Part of the team that engineered two mission-critical public-facing APIs that became industry standards: VADP (vStorage APIs for Data Protection) and VDDK (Virtual Disk Development Kit)
• This team designed and implemented Change Block Tracking for vSphere, significantly enhancing backup performance by focusing operations only on modified data blocks
• This team architected a proprietary deduplication datastore supporting multiple transport modes (SCSI Hotadd, SAN, NBD, NBDSSL) for efficient VM data protection
• This team developed a seamlessly integrated vSphere plugin that provided intuitive UI access to the underlying Retrospect engine
• Optimized the DAG (Dantz API Generator) framework to enable efficient UI-engine communication within the VMware environment
• Created innovative "Client Initiated Restore" functionality (both CLI and UI applications) that enabled secure, token-based restoration of backed-up VMs to user systems
• Implemented VDDK disklib plugin architecture to facilitate snapshot discovery and local system mounting, enhancing self-service recovery options
• Incorporated block-level data access protocols from DAG to optimize data transfer performance during restore operations
• Delivered the entire solution on schedule, ensuring its availability for the critical vSphere product release

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Led cross-platform engineering initiative that successfully ported the Retrospect backup engine to the Linux operating system, creating a unified codebase that functioned seamlessly on macOS, Windows, and Linux
• Co-developed DAG (Dantz API Generator), a proprietary RPC client-server architecture (C++/C server, C++/C/C# client) that enabled UI/engine separation and remote access control of Retrospect, significantly enhancing product flexibility
• Established comprehensive platform support matrix covering Mac OS Classic, Mac OSX, Windows (NT, XP, Server 2003, and beyond), and Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, and Redhat), addressing 99% of customer support needs
• Played role in the technical due diligence process during EMC's acquisition of Dantz, contributing to the successful $50-100M transaction in 2004
• Balanced management responsibilities with hands-on technical contributions, modeling the engineering excellence expected from team members
• Directed integration of Retrospect technologies into EMC's broader storage portfolio following acquisition, ensuring valuable IP was leveraged across the organization
• Managed resource allocation across multiple simultaneous development tracks while maintaining team cohesion and focus during corporate transition
• Mentored junior engineers through the acquisition process, maintaining productivity and morale during organizational change

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of core functionality for Retrospect backup software, a market-leading data protection solution used by millions of customers worldwide for over thirty years
• Was part of a team that implemented the multi-platform backup server application capable of running multiple concurrent backup processes across OSX, Linux/Unix, and Windows environments
• Pioneered Apple's transition to OSX by leading the port of Retrospect client software to alpha hardware during Apple's acquisition of NeXT systems, creating a process engine (C++) coupled with GUI (Objective-C)
• Delivered the first third-party product alpha tested by Apple and first to market when OSX was released to customers, showcasing the flexibility of Retrospect's plugin architecture
• Architected sophisticated client-side components that facilitated efficient data scanning, streaming, and block-level calculations using platform-specific file system event mechanisms (FSEvents for OSX, inotify for Linux, WatchDirectory for Windows)
• Implemented comprehensive testing frameworks to ensure exceptional reliability and data integrity in mission-critical backup scenarios
• Mentored junior engineers in best practices for cross-platform C++ development, emphasizing test-driven methodologies

positions.title: Member of Technicl Staff, IS&T
positions.description:
• Supported critical internal applications for Apple's worldwide operations, ensuring seamless functionality and minimal downtime
• Pioneered an innovative intern training program that systematically assigned specific applications to each intern, creating subject matter experts and improving overall support quality
• Developed a custom web server in 1992 that integrated with in-house databases to provide Apple executives real-time visibility into system status and critical issues
• Implemented early web technology solutions before they became industry standard, receiving recognition for technical innovation and foresight
• Maintained 24/7 uptime for mission-critical internal systems through proactive monitoring and rapid issue resolution

patents.title: Remote access architecture enabling a client to perform an operation
patents.description: Enabling a client computer to perform an operation is disclosed. Login information is received from a client computer. The login information is confirmed by querying a trusted agent on the client computer.

patents.title: Client initiated restore
patents.description: Client initiated restore is disclosed. An indication is received from a client computer that a restore operation is desired. Access to a backup data associated with the client computer is provided to the client computer. The backup data associated with the client computer comprises a subset of a backup data set that includes both backup data associated with the client computer and backup data not associated with the client computer.
